body:
Prepared a light UI concept from the owner's screenshot references, covering
Focus, Project, Board, Calendar, Timeline, List and Updates as fourteen screens
on one desktop/mobile presentation board. The direction combines white cards,
pale gray containers, subtle depth, charcoal controls and restrained blue.

The raster is a visual proposal with synthetic data and some generated-detail
limitations. Application behavior, scope, priorities, statuses and acceptance
remain unchanged. Image, prompts and notes are in test-results/ui-design-2026-09-25;
the concise evidence record is progress/2026-09-25-light-ui-design-concept.md.

metadata.summary: Prepared a light UI concept for seven desktop and mobile views
